guide.step1.title: Export your FIT file from Garmin Connect
guide.step1.step1: Open Garmin Connect at connect.garmin.com on your computer
guide.step1.step2: Go to Activities and find the activity recorded without GPS
guide.step1.step3: Click the gear icon (⚙) in the top-right corner of the activity page
guide.step1.step4: Select "Export Original" — this downloads the original .fit file
guide.step1.note: The activity must be synced from your device first. "Export Original" preserves all sensor data (HR, cadence, power, pace).
guide.step2.title: Get a GPX track file for the same route
guide.step2.intro: You need a GPX file that covers the same route you ran or rode. This can come from:
guide.step2.strava.label: Strava
guide.step2.strava1: Open the matching activity or segment in Strava
guide.step2.strava2: Click the ••• menu (More options) → Export GPX
guide.step2.garmin.label: Garmin Connect
guide.step2.garmin1: Open any activity or saved course that covers the route
guide.step2.garmin2: Click the gear icon → Export to GPX
guide.step2.other: Any GPX file from Komoot, Ride with GPS, AllTrails, or a GPS-enabled device also works.
guide.step3.title: Process with this tool
guide.step3.step1: Upload your .fit file using the FIT Activity File field
guide.step3.step2: Upload your .gpx track using the GPX Track File field
guide.step3.step3: Click "Add GPS to FIT" and wait a moment for processing
guide.step3.step4: Review the map preview and stats — the red line is the generated GPS track
guide.step3.step5: Click "Download FIT File" to save the result
guide.step3.note: GPS coordinates are interpolated from your activity's recorded distance, so the accuracy depends on how closely the GPX route matches the actual path.
guide.step4.title: Upload the processed file
guide.step4.garmin.label: Garmin Connect
guide.step4.garmin1: Go to Garmin Connect and click the + button (top right)
guide.step4.garmin2: Select Import Data, then choose your new .fit file
guide.step4.garmin3: The activity will appear on the map with GPS coordinates
guide.step4.strava.label: Strava
guide.step4.strava2: Select your new .fit file and complete the upload
guide.step4.note: If you already have the activity on Garmin Connect or Strava, delete the original first, then upload the GPS-enhanced version.
